text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Secret Scroll" and keywords to reach 
Eden...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps all of that was part of a 
calculated strategy to spur Gold Ship into 
running her best race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Either way, considering she's genuinely 
motivated herself now, it must be a 
success.
choice_data_list: (I'll just go with the flow for now!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I headed out to training today as well to 
prepare for our next race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, Gold Ship is nowhere to be 
seen on the track today either. I had no 
choice but to wander around the academy 
looking for her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After walking around the academy, I 
eventually reached the rooftop—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
How strange. I've experienced countless 
nail-biting matches before, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Feels like you're acting tougher than ever 
today, Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Something inside me is telling me I have 
to beat you—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never reach Eden unless I surpass 
you...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh. I don't really get all this Eden 
stuff, but sounds fun to me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you wanna challenge me, you're more 
than welcome to. Especially... the hotter 
the heat, the better."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright... let's get started right away. 
Before the hype cools down!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect timing, Trainer! You're gonna be 
my witness again today!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, we're dashing 
through at Mach speed! Oraa, stay right on 
my tail!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to hurry and chase after Gold 
Ship and the others...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First, a classic! A spicy food contest! 
Bring that out, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Alright, here I go!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
One super spicy toasted sandwich, with 
extra habanero chili sauce, coming right 
uuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, that is entirely red... It 
looks mercilessly spicy...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's a serious showdown, after all...! 
Alright, here I gooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! That was seriously, insanely 
spicy...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*cough, wheeze*...! But I finished it all! 
*choke*...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! You both finished your plates! This 
match is a draaaaw!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My mouth is still burning... but next up 
is abs! Ryan, I'm countin' on you!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Alright, time for the 100 sit-ups in 
1 minute challenge! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
100 times in one minute... you say? Haha, 
sounds good. Now that's interesting...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Good grief, this is pure 
insanity...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!! Still, we both gave it 
our all... *BLEAARGH*!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, you two! Exactly 100 times! Looks 
like this match ends in a draw!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa... Isn't this crazy different 
from how you usually do things?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, after all, in the end it's a contest 
of pretending to be bronze statues in 
front of the crowd!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hah?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Bamboo! Show 'em what you've got 
like the Disciplinary Committee Chairman 
you are!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha, I just gotta keep an eye on them 
so they don't move, right? Alright, let's 
start!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you actually being serious...?

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Hey Mama, what are those big sisters 
doing~?

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Shh, don't stare so much...!

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey, isn't that a student from 
our school?"

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're right. What are they doing? 
So mysterious...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
......Damn it, I've reached my limit!!!! 
What the hell was that embarrassing 
match...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you moved, didn't you. —Too bad, 
that's Nakayama's loss!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: YESSS!! We won, we won!! WE WOOOOONNNN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You got me, Golshi...! You dragged me 
hook, line, and sinker right onto your 
home turf!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
However, regardless of the terms, a match 
is a match...! I accept the outcome...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Next time we compete, I'll drag you onto 
my home turf and beat you fair and 
square!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'll keep my fists warm until 
it's time for our rematch, too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Victory over Nakayama Festa!! (To be 
continued)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the bafflingly heated showdown 
came to a close with Gold Ship's 
victory...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Phew, I'm completely burned out... Black 
as iron pot gyoza left out overnight.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, we beat that Nakayama. With this, 
we'll surely reach it... Eden, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, she has mentioned 
Eden several times today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'd totally forgotten it even existed 
before, so when did I get this 
enthusiastic about it...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hm, what's with you? Is Golshi-chan's 
serious mode really that mind-boggling?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, fine. I'll tell ya, but only you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I've been having these weird 
dreams all the time. Some mysterious voice 
keeps telling me to come to Eden or 
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And even though it's a completely 
nonsensical dream, for some reason, the 
voice feels strangely nostalgic...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It's like this sense of nostalgia I feel 
around McQueen, yet at the same time, this 
feeling of closeness like with Nakayama...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, when it comes to nostalgia, it still 
can't beat the smell of tatami mats at 
Grandpa's place, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was actually a completely sensible 
reason for it...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, when talking about Eden, the 
"Secret Scroll" is a must.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could the person who prepared the “Secret 
Scroll” possibly even have the ability to 
appear in my dreams...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm bored, so let's head back~. 
I'm gonna do a quick full-power sprint, so 
try to keep up~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though slightly bothered by it, I decided 
to chase after Gold Ship.
